# Stella Maynard

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** country school teacher  <sub>[v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** rose-red  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Stella is a vivid, black-eyed girl who carried off the palm for beauty in the Second Year classes at Queen's Academy.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Personality

Stella is thoughtful, imaginative, and ambitious, possessing a heartful of wistful dreams and fancies as aerial and rainbow-like as Anne's own. She takes life and relationships seriously, occasionally offering severe advice to lighter-hearted companions.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v3 c25 P18](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0018)_

## Traits

- thoughtful  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- imaginative  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- ambitious  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- serious  <sub>[v3 c25 P18](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0018)</sub>

## History

Stella attended Queen's Academy, where she became part of an intimate circle of friends with Anne Shirley and Priscilla Grant. After graduating, she spent time teaching school until deciding to further her education at Redmond College. She proposed a plan to keep house with her friends, leading them to rent Patty's Place alongside her aunt, Aunt Jamesina. During her final year at Redmond, she engaged in a steady grind of study and ultimately obtained a good all-round showing upon graduation.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v3 c9 P6](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0006), [v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v3 c10 P47](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0047), [v3 c16 P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 c35 P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028), [v3 c37 P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029)_

- Studied at Queen's Academy in the Second Year class  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
